name: ES Endogenous Impact Half-Life Relay v1
instrument: ES transaction-price signal executed with one MES using recorded MBP-1 quotes
source: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ES trades and MES MBP-1
hypothesis: A large endogenous price displacement is useful only through the market's subsequent repair response. If at least half of the selected displacement remains at the participant handoff, it represents accepted information and should persist. If less than half remains, the impact was temporary liquidity debt and should continue repairing.

signal.event_displacement: last transaction price minus first transaction price in a minute
signal.event_selection: minute with greatest absolute nonzero event displacement; earliest minute wins an exact tie
signal.event_midpoint: arithmetic midpoint of the selected minute's first and last transaction prices
signal.retained_state: last transaction price before 15:30 remains on the event-direction side of or exactly at the event midpoint
signal.repaired_state: last transaction price before 15:30 is beyond the event midpoint opposite the event direction
signal.trade_direction: follow event direction in retained state; fade event direction in repaired state
signal.zero_or_missing_rule: no trade if no nonzero event displacement exists or a required price is missing

execution.entry_time: first MES MBP-1 record at or after 15:30:05 ET
execution.stop: none; one MES and a fixed approximately 29-minute holding period bound exposure
execution.exit_time: first recorded MES MBP-1 quote at or after 15:59:45 ET
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

economics.slippage_model: the full recorded MES bid-ask spread is crossed at entry and exit; no additional modeled slippage

lesson: The repair response was more informative than the original shock, but the complete state machine failed 2023 and longs. Selecting only repaired shocks or shorts would be post-hoc rescue.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: changing the event-search window or recovery horizon
selecting by signed volume, event magnitude, time, side, weekday, volatility, or regime
changing the natural 50 percent retention boundary
reversing only one state after observing results
adding stops or changing execution times
